description:
In his first season with the Vancouver Canucks, Kiefer Sherwood makes a statement by recording his first career hat trick. He kickstarts the scoring early, then follows it up with an unassisted shorthanded beauty in the second period. Breaking up a play at his own blue line, Sherwood takes off, leaving defenders in his dust before ripping a shot past the goalie for what would stand as the game winner. He caps off the night by sealing the deal with an empty-netter, accounting for all three Canucks goals in their 3-1 victory.

description:
Acquired in a midseason trade by Colorado, Mackenzie Blackwood put his athleticism on full display with a spectacular save against the Minnesota Wild. After making the initial stop, the puck was sent to David Jiricek, who slipped in backdoor with what looked like a sure goal. But Blackwood slid across just in time to deny the one-timer, leaving the crowd in awe.

description:
In his third game with the Buffalo Sabres, James Reimer delivers an unbelievable save during a San Jose Sharks power play. Macklin Celebrini blasts a one-timer from the side, seemingly bound for the back of the net, but Reimer slides over just in time to get a piece of it with his glove. As the puck bounces high in the air and toward the goal, Reimer quickly turns his glove over, snagging it mid-air to make the highlight-reel stop.
